name: Monomodule FX (Gen2)
author: sd88me
summary: The Elektron Monomachine's seven effect machines (thru, reverb, chorus, dynamix, ring mod, phaser, flanger) as an audio effect for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links. A ready-made download with nothing of Elektron's in it: it reads your own Monomachine OS file from the plugin folder. Gen2 only.
